newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria FinMin says reopens CA tender until Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: Austria FinMin says reopens CA tender until Jan 10.

text.p: Austria's Finance Ministry said on Friday that it reopened a tender for the sale of the country's second biggest bank, Creditanstalt, to allow bidders to improve their offers.
The ministry said in a statement that it set a new deadline of January 10.

The ministry made public the offers put in by two of the three bidders. It said Bank Austria had made an offer of 836 schillings per share for the whole of the government's 70 percent stake in the flagship bank. This amounts to a total of 16.7 billion schillings.

The consortium led by Italian-controlled insurer EA-Generali had offered 730 schillings per share for 14.7 million shares and 580 schillings for the remaining 5.2 million shares, which they planned to float on the stock market, the finance ministry said. The third bid made by Austrian entrepreneur Karl Wlaschek was not disclosed, but his bid has been estimated at around 15 billion schillings.
